evidence.quote: Unemployment is now at 3.6 percent—its lowest level in 50 years.
Importantly, wage growth has begun to pick up after years of slow gains.
Monetary policy aims to influence employment and inflation over the business cycle, as opposed to addressing these longer-run structural changes.
Long-term, the shifting of wealth and income to the top of the distribution and away from the middle could pose challenges to the health and resilience of our economy.

parsed.rationale: The speech is mainly about middle-class wealth and distributional data, with no signal on rates, inflation or the balance sheet. It describes a strong labor market alongside structural concerns about inequality and consumption, giving a near-neutral, very slightly dovish tone.
